description: bead-groups data for finding-group: the attach ref and the relations `sc-compose bead attach` adds with the group. The group attaches under the sprint container; there is no finding bead for a blocking finding. Endpoints are `step:<step>` (a step of this group) or `bead:<id>`, format strings over {vars[<name>]}.

A.description: E1 option A: only the fix is poured; its sanity bead is created when the fix closes.

B.description: E1 option B: the poured sanity step has no `needs fix`; sanity and QA each `validates` the fix.

C.description: E1 option C, the existing schema: sanity `blocks` the fix (poured from `needs`) with metadata.dev_bead; QA `validates` the fix.

relations.description: the fix bead was found while working the QA bead that filed it
